messages.text: Quiet hours are in force.
Dust storm forecast in about 3 months: charge the batteries, and expect little from the solar arrays while it blows.
Supply drop delayed a month by dust over the landing zone.
Kian Reyes says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (smell).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
[[room:35|Machine shop|5]] built.
[[room:37|Staging bay|5]] built.
The planter bed (algae) in [[room:16|Potato farm|2]] broke down: it's down to 46%.
Supply drop landed: colonists 1, earth rations 233, water 76, oxygen 621, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.
Sana Reyes says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (the home itself).
Lars Silva is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
[[room:25|Stairwell|1]] extended.
[[room:39|Warehouse|1]] built.
[[room:40|Rover depot|S]] built.
Lars Silva says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (crowding).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
[[room:41|Warehouse|2]] built.
A dust storm has blown in: the solar arrays are making much less.
Bo Achebe is waiting at the office: noise complaint.
Quiet hours are in force.
